purpose: does a direction margin cover the errors that actually occur at C
group: the six location-reference rolepair rows, taken whole; the seven blind-review reversals all map into this half

reproduction.verdict: all six reproduce the reversal; none is repetition, omission or a possessive addition

finding.pairwise: the correct and reversed sentences score within 0.02 per token of each other, so the model does not prefer the wrong reading, it fails to separate the two
finding.activation: because the gap is about zero, all six rows activate at m = 1 with a term close to full strength
finding.coverage: the loss compares exactly these two sentences, so it is aimed at the observed error rather than at a proxy
limits: the pair also changes the surface frame (压在X上的Y against X压着的Y), so what is learned may be the frame, not the direction
the preference is a tie, so training must create a one-nat separation rather than correct a strong wrong preference
all six rows are design rows, not a holdout

corrections: the margin pushes both sides: it raises the correct score as well as lowering the reversed one
a 3.7 percent gradient-norm rise does not imply a 3.7 percent update rise under AdamW
generating wrong while preferring the correct target is not a reason to start a margin; it signals the scoring proxy and free generation disagree, and a satisfied margin has no gradient
